name: Curtain Rise
description: The first clip rises like a theater festoon curtain: cords lift its hem into scalloped swags while the fabric gathers into shaded ruffles, and it is drawn up out of the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: swags
params.description: Number of swags across a 16:9 frame (fewer in portrait)

params.name: sag
params.description: How low each swag droops between two cords, as a part of the frame height

params.name: ruffles
params.description: Number of gathered ruffles in the fabric

params.name: shading
params.description: Depth of the shading on the ruffles and swags, and of the shadow under the hem
